Not listed in the official requirements.

Degree certificate(s) with final grades. If your latest one is not ready, upload a provisional document and send the final one before the funding starts. PDF; add a German or English translation if needed.
Current grade overview or transcript of records with individual grades. PDF; if not in German or English, upload a translation together with the original.
CV in tabular form, maximum 3 pages.
Letter of motivation, 1-3 pages, on your study project and your academic and personal reasons for it.
Letter of motivation, 1-2 pages: academic and personal reasons for the project and what you hope to gain personally and professionally.
Letter of motivation, 1-2 pages: academic and personal reasons for the project and what you hope to gain personally and professionally.
One recent letter from a university teacher (doctoral applicants: your thesis supervisor), on the DAAD form you create in the portal during the application period. Your referee must fill it in fully.
Proof of the language of your programme (German or English), required even if the university does not ask. Not older than 3 years. German: e.g. TestDaF, DSH, Goethe. English: e.g. IELTS, TOEFL iBT.
Proof of the language of your programme (German or English), required even if the university does not ask. Not older than 3 years. German: e.g. TestDaF, DSH, Goethe. English: e.g. IELTS, TOEFL iBT.
Letter of admission from the host university. If you do not have it when you apply, submit it before the funding period begins.
Letter of admission from the host university. If you do not have it when you apply, submit it before the funding period begins.
Only if you join a structured doctoral programme: letter of admission (may be sent later) and proof of contact with the programme coordinator. Some programmes ask for proof of admission or enrolment.
Proposal plus description of your previous research work, maximum 10 pages in total. Write it yourself and discuss it with your academic adviser.
Research proposal, maximum 10 pages in total. Write it yourself and discuss it with your German academic adviser.
Research schedule agreed with your supervisor (individual project), or the module plan if you join a structured doctoral programme.
Time schedule of your planned research work.
Individual project: letter from your doctoral supervisor confirming supervision. Upload under acceptance of host institution.
Confirmation from the German host institution that refers to your project and guarantees you a workplace.
Declaration from your German scientific supervisor on safety-relevant and ethical aspects of the project.
Supervisor's form on safety-relevant and ethical aspects of the project.
List of publications, maximum 10 pages, if you have any.
List of publications, maximum 10 pages.
Other relevant documents, such as employment certificates, proof of internships or practical training, or proof of voluntary commitment.
